title: Portable skill body frontmatter v1alpha1
description: Frontmatter contract for a SKILL.md, the portable body of a skill. This file must be liftable into any repository or harness, so it carries no catalogue placement: no id, no status, no ledger title. Those live in the K* stub beside it, which is meaningless once the skill leaves this catalogue. The description is the routing surface a harness reads, which is why its shape is constrained here rather than left to convention.

name.description: The skill's own name, and how a harness loads it. Must match the directory that holds the body.

description.description: What the skill does and the condition under which to use it. A harness surfaces this and nothing else when deciding whether to load, so the condition belongs in the first sentence. See S14 for the condition-versus-topic test.

when_to_use.description: Conditions that widen the description's trigger. Optional; the description must already carry one.

when_not_to_use.description: Conditions that exclude this skill, so an agent can rule it out rather than infer.

related_skills.description: Sibling skills worth knowing about. Not an edge: prerequisite and composes carry the graph.

license.description: Present only on vendored third-party content, where the licence travels with the body.

metadata.description: Graph edges and provenance for vendored content. tools/skill-graph.mjs reads prerequisite and composes.

prerequisite.description: Skills to read first. Must resolve to a real skill; skill-graph enforces that and acyclicity.

composes.description: Primitives this specialist system is built from. Level is derived from these edges, never stored in a name.

source.description: Upstream origin. Present only on vendored content, and its presence exempts the description from this corpus's shaping conventions, because the text is not ours to reshape.
